تستعرفون (form X)
# تَسْتَعْرِفُونَ (tastaʕrifūna) /tas.taʕ.ri.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْرَفَ (istaʕrafa)
# تُسْتَعْرَفُونَ (tustaʕrafūna) /tus.taʕ.ra.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْرَفَ (istaʕrafa)
